row.reason: Both are branded manufacturers of building-related materials that sell through distributors and home-improvement retail, and both serve construction and industrial manufacturers. Their products differ. Owens Corning makes shingles, insulation and glass-fiber composites. PPG makes paints and coatings, plus aerospace, automotive and packaging coatings. The customer overlap is partial (contractors, builders, distributors, home centers). The product overlap is limited, so this is adjacent and not a direct competitor.
